$comment: FR-25 akta-parity company profiles. Sections/field lists mirror akta.pro's Company Data dictionary (16 sections / 74 L2 fields). Tiers, grouping, freshness and crawl behavior are policy: edit here without deploy. mandated_sections gate serving exactly like enrichment.mandated_fields gates articles (R05 analog).
$tier_note: LLM sections are grouped so one call carries consecutive same-tier sections; groups never mix tiers.

crawl.$comment: politeFetch is robots.txt-aware + rate-limited (1req/2s/domain); paths are tried in order until max_pages succeed.

field_hints.firmographic: name; legal_name; website; company_type enum(Private|Public|Subsidiary|Nonprofit|Government); founded_year int; company_description (long narrative incl products+GTM+funding facts); company_description_short (1-2 sentences); operating_status {code,label} code in (operating|acquired|shut_down); ownership_category {code,label} e.g venture_backed|bootstrapped|public|private_equity_backed; headcount_range bucket string like 101-250; website_screenshot url|null
field_hints.product_offering: brand[{name,description,source[]}]; core_offering str; differentiator str; functional_benefit str; problem_solved str; quantifiable_outcome[str]; product_overview str; product_and_service[{name,category|null,description|null,url|null,image_url|null,source[]}]
field_hints.industry: keyword[str]; industry[{code,label,is_primary}] codes are free 8-char ids only if seen in evidence else omit; naics[{code,label}]; sic[{code,label}]; product_category str|null
field_hints.financial_estimate: revenue_estimate {code,label} bracket like 1M-10M|10M-50M|50M-100M|100M-250M|250M-500M|500M-1B|1B-5B|OVER-5B|null; valuation_estimate {code,label} bracket like UNDER-10M|10M-50M|50M-250M|250M-1B|1B-5B|5B-10B|10B-25B|OVER-25B|null
field_hints.mna_and_investment: mna[{acquiree{name,uuid|null,website|null},acquisition_type{code,label},announced_date{day,month,year}|null,completed_date|null,amount_usd|null,status complete|pending,id|null,news[{publisher,title,url}]}]; investment[] same shape from the investor side
field_hints.company_assessment: market_position str; strengths[{headline,details,source[]}]; weakness[...same]; competitive_moat[{type,details}] type in (data_advantage|switching_costs|distribution_advantage|cost_advantage|intangible_assets|ecosystem_lock_in|network_effects); key_risks[...]; key_highlights[...]; customer_concentration {classification Low|Medium|High, details}|null; peers[{name,description,type direct_peer|broad_incumbent|emerging_player}]
field_hints.management_profile: number_of_profiles int; profiles[{name,designation,designation_category CXO|VP|Director|Head of Department|Co-founder|Chief Executive Officer|Board Member,overview,profile_commentary|null,previous_companies[str],start_date{day,month,year}|null,source[]}]
field_hints.technology: is_technology_focussed bool; api_detail {has_api bool,has_mcp bool,docs_url|null,sdk_language[str],description|null}|null; integration[{title,description|null,type,source[]}]; ai_capability[{type,description,source[]}]; ai_maturity {scale 1-5,label,description}|null; app_detail {has_app bool,app_url|null}|null; feature[{title,description,differentiator{code,label}|null,source[]}]; core_technology str|null
